text:
Beginning: Sophia, a talented but timid aspiring musician, struggles with severe stage fright that prevents her from performing publicly, causing her to hide her musical gifts despite her passion.

Climax: After finding inspiration and courage through interactions with seasoned artists, Sophia faces her ultimate test at a major music festival. On stage, she confronts her fear head-on, channeling her anxiety into her performance and successfully delivering a powerful, resonant show that captivates the audience.

Resolution: Her breakthrough performance at the festival marks the end of her struggle with stage fright and serves as the launching pad for her rising career, establishing her as a confident and recognized artist.

The transparent material used to make windows is glass.
